title: Epoch Economic Simulation Suite Summary (S-1 to S-5)
label: model result under these assumptions

H1.statement: Epoch lowers maker adverse-selection loss relative to CLOB with multiple snipers (k=5)
H1.metric: 91.0% reduction in maker adverse selection loss [SIMULATED]

H2.statement: With one dominant sniper (k=1), the reduction in adverse selection shrinks toward zero

H3.statement: H3: Some maker offset gives non-negative expected PnL for a given lambda; required offset grows with lambda and snipers k
H3.metric: Inner 3 bps rung loses -2.67 bps; widened 12 bps rung achieves 6.973 bps under 5.0 bps fee [SIMULATED]

H4.statement: H4: Cranker oracle-selection option is worth less than the fee per trade in a tight window (W=4)
H4.metric: W=4 option 1.611 bps is 32.2% of 5.0 bps fee (strictly below fee) [SIMULATED]

H5.statement: H5: With target-ahead, at least 90% of orders land in their target batch
H5.metric: N=2, L=3 gives 68.87%; N=2, L=5 gives 98.9% on-time landing [SIMULATED]

H6.statement: Uninformed traders pay less (or not more) in Epoch than in CLOB
H6.metric: Uninformed cost 5.993 bps in Epoch vs 6.013 bps in CLOB [SIMULATED]

threats_audit.R1_toxic_flow: Inner 3 bps rung loses to toxic flow under fee_bps=5; break-even requires offset >= 11 bps (widened ladder rungs: [12, 18, 25] bps)
threats_audit.R2_cranker_option: Cranker option is 1.611 bps (W=4, 32.2% of fee); keeper racing prevents delayed clearing abuse
threats_audit.R4_last_look: Ordering-based sandwiches are impossible by construction due to uniform price clearing; last-look informational advantage (Threat R4) is NOT addressed
threats_audit.R6_vault_solvency: Aligned ladder [12, 18, 25] bps maintains strictly positive expected PnL (+6.97 bps on inner rung)
